title: Deciphering the Monomeric and Dimeric Conformational Landscapes of the Full-Length TDP-43 and the Impact of the C-Terminal Domain.
authors: Tammara, Vaishnavi; Doke, Abhilasha A; Jha, Santosh Kumar; Das, Atanu
one_liner_zh: 该文用多尺度模拟研究全长TDP-43蛋白单体和二聚体的构象景观，聚焦蛋白自身聚集而非TF-DNA互作，但涉及蛋白-DNA结合域（TDP-43为DNA结合蛋白）及分子动力学模拟方法，对蛋白-核酸互作建模有方法学参考价值。
abstract: The aberrant aggregation of TAR DNA-binding protein 43 kDa (TDP-43) in cells leads to the pathogenesis of multiple fatal neurodegenerative diseases. Decoding the proposed initial transition between its functional dimeric and aggregation-prone monomeric states can potentially design a viable therapeutic strategy, which is presently limited by the lack of structural detail of the full-length TDP-43. To achieve a complete understanding of such a delicate phase space, we employed a multiscale simulation approach that unearths numerous crucial features, broadly summarized in two categories: (1) state-independent features that involve inherent chain collapsibility, rugged polymorphic landscape dictated by the terminal domains, high beta-sheet propensity, structural integrity preserved by backbone-based intrachain hydrogen bonds and electrostatic forces, the prominence of the C-terminal domain in the intrachain cross-domain interfaces, and equal participation of hydrophobic and hydrophilic (charged and polar) residues in cross-domain interfaces; and (2) dimerization-modulated characteristics that encompass slower collapsing dynamics, restricted polymorphic landscape, the dominance of side chains in interchain hydrogen bonds, the appearance of the N-terminal domain in the dimer interface, and the prominence of hydrophilic (specifically polar) residues in interchain homo- and cross-domain interfaces. In our work, the ill-known C-terminal domain appears as the most crucial structure-dictating domain, which preferably populates a compact conformation with a high beta-sheet propensity in its isolated state stabilized by intrabackbone hydrogen bonds, and these signatures are comparatively faded in its integrated form. Validation of our simulated observables by a complementary spectroscopic approach on multiple counts ensures the robustness of the computationally predicted features of the TDP-43 aggregation landscape.
abstract_zh: TAR DNA结合蛋白43 kDa（TDP-43）在细胞中的异常聚集导致多种致命神经退行性疾病的发病机制。解码其功能性二聚体与易聚集单体状态之间提出的初始转变，可能设计出可行的治疗策略，但目前受限于全长TDP-43结构细节的缺乏。为全面理解这一精细的相空间，我们采用多尺度模拟方法，揭示了众多关键特征，大致归纳为两类：（1）状态无关特征，涉及固有链塌缩性、由末端结构域决定的崎岖多态性景观、高β-折叠倾向、由主链内氢键和静电力维持的结构完整性、C末端结构域在链内跨结构域界面中的突出作用，以及疏水和亲水（带电和极性）残基在跨结构域界面中的均等参与；（2）二聚化调节特征，包括较慢的塌缩动力学、受限的多态性景观、侧链在链间氢键中的主导地位、N末端结构域在二聚体界面中的出现，以及亲水（特别是极性）残基在链间同源和跨结构域界面中的突出作用。在我们的工作中，鲜为人知的C末端结构域表现为最关键的结构决定结构域，其在分离状态下偏好于填充紧凑构象，具有高β-折叠倾向，由主链内氢键稳定，而这些特征在其整合形式中相对减弱。通过互补光谱方法在多个方面对我们模拟观测值的验证，确保了计算预测的TDP-43聚集景观特征的稳健性。
